theme: An open day, girls home in St. Pete.
greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan — a rare open stretch with the girls home. The one thing worth doing while it's quiet is answering the CIFIC recruiter.

needsAttention.title: Amin's note on the CIFIC VP role is still unanswered
needsAttention.detail: The recruiter at Noorani + Partners followed up after your virtual meeting about the VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs search at CIFIC, and closed with: "I would be happy to discuss it further should you wish to consider it." Four days in, no reply has gone back.

needsAttention.title: The Maine Christmas SUV still isn't booked
needsAttention.detail: Your own p1 note flagged this as the item most likely to bite — a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week, held early while inventory lasts. It's been open since mid-September.

needsAttention.title: The December destination decision is past its own deadline
needsAttention.detail: Shortlist and pick for the Dec 13 – Jan 2 window with all four girls; your note set a book-by of Oct 15, now passed, and holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year.

flagged.title: CIFIC VP role — recruiter follow-up
flagged.detail: Amin Noorani's warm note with the role's job description attached, awaiting your reply.

inbox.noise: The rest is travel confirmations (Airbnb, Kiwi) and a few shop newsletters.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Warming and earthy, built for the turn into cooler weather.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — king bedframe + outdoor soap holder

acts.line: Nothing is on the calendar before noon — the quiet is yours to spend on the thing that matters most.
The afternoon stays open too; a rare uninterrupted stretch with no meeting to break it.
The evening is clear, with the girls home — room to cook something slow from scratch.
